name: What should I consider when choosing a general contractor for my home improvement project?
description: Consider experience, communication, licensing, insurance, detailed proposals, references, and understanding of local building codes.

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing a general contractor for my home improvement project?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a general contractor, prioritize experience, clear communication, and a strong portfolio of completed projects. Verify their licensing and insurance. Look for contractors who offer detailed proposals, transparent pricing, and can provide references. A good contractor should also demonstrate a solid understanding of local building codes and permits required in areas like Huntington Beach or Irvine.
